source_name: BLM 2024 Western Solar Plan (Utility-Scale Solar Energy Development PEIS) Record of Decision geodatabase, layer Solar_PEIS_ROD_Approved_Plan; BLM Energy Designations, layer 12 BLM DRECP Development Focus Area (DFA); BLM Energy Designations, layer 13 BLM DRECP Variance Land

fields.sez_name: Solar Energy Zone(s) the polygon touches, if any

caveats: Western Solar Plan (2024 ROD, Approved Plan) polygons with ApprovedPlan = 'Available', dissolved per state and split into contiguous parts. 'Available' means open to right-of-way applications, not approved or free of conflicts. In California most BLM desert land is labelled 'DRECP/CDCA' in the ROD because it is governed by the DRECP land use plan amendment; for those lands this layer adds BLM DRECP Development Focus Areas and Variance Lands from the BLM Energy Designations service. Variance lands need a variance process and carry more risk than DFAs. Polygons under 1 acre were dropped. GeoJSON for the map: simplify 0.001 deg, holes and parts under 5 acres removed; full resolution in blm_solar_available.gpkg. Acres by state/category: AZ Available (2024 Western Solar Plan ROD): 2,813,958; CA Available (2024 Western Solar Plan ROD): 163,757; CA DRECP Development Focus Area (CA): 388,723; CA DRECP Variance Land (CA): 40,161; NM Available (2024 Western Solar Plan ROD): 4,018,684; NV Available (2024 Western Solar Plan ROD): 8,851,565; UT Available (2024 Western Solar Plan ROD): 4,783,026. Policy note: Interior's 2025 orders added senior review for solar and wind on federal land; availability here is the land-use-plan status only.
app_simplification: simplify 0.001 deg, holes and parts under 5 acres removed

source_name: USFWS Critical Habitat, Final Critical Habitat Features (polygons)
caveats: Final designated critical habitat polygons only (proposed and line features not included). Species ranges and occupied habitat outside designations (e.g. much desert tortoise habitat) are not captured. GeoJSON map copy: simplify 0.0005 deg; full resolution in exclusions_full.gpkg layer 'critical_habitat'.

source_name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL), layer 28 Flood Hazard Zones, zones A/AE/AH/AO/V/VE
caveats: FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area zones A, AE, AH, AO, V, VE from the NFHL service (geometry generalised server-side to ~30 m). A99 and AR (levee-protected) are not included. NFHL does not cover every county; unmapped areas (common in rural NV, UT, NM, AZ) are not flood-free. 143 FIRM study areas present. GeoJSON map copy: simplify 0.0005 deg, holes and parts under 2 acres removed and dissolved by ['subtype', 'state']; full resolution in exclusions_full.gpkg layer 'flood_zone_a'.
app_simplification: simplify 0.0005 deg, holes and parts under 2 acres removed

source_name: US Census Bureau TIGER/Line 2024 Military Installations; BLM National Surface Management Agency Area Polygons (SMA_WM.gdb, BLM EGIS hub item 6bf2e737c59d4111be92420ee5ab0b46)
caveats: Military installations (TIGER) plus DOD-managed land (SMA). Military training routes, special use airspace and DOD siting-clearinghouse review areas are not included; those affect tall structures and glare and need DOD consultation. GeoJSON map copy: simplify 0.0005 deg; full resolution in exclusions_full.gpkg layer 'military'.

source_name: BLM National NLCS National Monuments and National Conservation Areas Polygons; BLM National Areas of Critical Environmental Concern, ACEC Designated Polygons
caveats: BLM National Monuments and National Conservation Areas are hard (excluded from solar under the Western Solar Plan). ACECs are soft here as the brief asks, but note the 2024 Western Solar Plan excludes ACECs from solar on BLM land; on BLM land use blm_solar_available as the controlling layer. GeoJSON map copy: simplify 0.0005 deg; full resolution in exclusions_full.gpkg layer 'nca_acec'.

source_name: BLM National Surface Management Agency Area Polygons (SMA_WM.gdb, BLM EGIS hub item 6bf2e737c59d4111be92420ee5ab0b46)
caveats: National Park Service lands from BLM SMA. Not available for solar ROW. GeoJSON map copy: simplify 0.0005 deg; full resolution in exclusions_full.gpkg layer 'nps'.

source_name: AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles (terrarium encoding, zoom 11), built mainly from USGS 3DEP / NED elevation
caveats: Derived: slope.tif aggregated to 6x6-pixel cells (~0.005 deg, ~45-55 ha); a cell is steep when at least half its pixels exceed 5 percent. Pieces under 100 acres were dropped. Use slope.tif for site-level slope; this layer is a screening mask. GeoJSON map copy: simplify 0.002 deg; full resolution in exclusions_full.gpkg layer 'slope_gt5'.

source_name: US Census Bureau TIGER/Line 2024 American Indian / Alaska Native / Native Hawaiian Areas
caveats: Reservations, off-reservation trust land and other Census tribal areas. Treated as hard for a BLM/private screen; development on tribal land is possible only with the tribe as partner (BIA/tribal process, not BLM). GeoJSON map copy: simplify 0.0005 deg; full resolution in exclusions_full.gpkg layer 'tribal'.

source_name: US Census Bureau TIGER/Line 2024 Urban Areas (2020 Census)
caveats: 2020 Census urban areas (>= 2,000 housing units or 5,000 people). Hard for utility-scale solar; data center sites near urban edges may still be relevant. GeoJSON map copy: simplify 0.0005 deg; full resolution in exclusions_full.gpkg layer 'urban'.

source_name: USFWS National Wetlands Inventory map service, wetlands >= 40 acres
caveats: Proxy: only NWI polygons of 40 acres or more are included (full NWI is too heavy), so small wetlands, springs and washes are missing. Includes lakes, ponds and riverine polygons as mapped by NWI. Soft constraint; site-level delineation needed. GeoJSON map copy: simplify 0.002 deg, holes and parts under 20 acres removed and dissolved by ['subtype', 'state']; full resolution in exclusions_full.gpkg layer 'wetlands'.
app_simplification: simplify 0.002 deg, holes and parts under 20 acres removed

source_name: Wilderness Connect (University of Montana) National Wilderness Preservation System boundaries; BLM National NLCS Wilderness Study Areas Polygons
caveats: Designated wilderness (all agencies) and BLM Wilderness Study Areas. Both are closed to solar ROWs. GeoJSON map copy: simplify 0.0005 deg; full resolution in exclusions_full.gpkg layer 'wilderness'.

source_name: NREL NSRDB Physical Solar Model v3 GHI multi-year (1998-2016) annual average, 0.04 deg (nsrdbv3_ghi.zip; Internet Archive copy of NREL's file)

fields.band 1: annual average daily global horizontal irradiance, kWh/m2/day (nodata -9999 outside the five states)

caveats: NSRDB PSM v3 multi-year mean 1998-2016 at 0.04 deg (~4 km) cells, so values are smooth at site scale. The bundled metadata text says kWh/m2/year but values (3.7 to 6.3) are kWh/m2/day, matching NREL's published map. A north-south seam near 105W in eastern New Mexico is present in the NSRDB source (satellite coverage boundary), not added here. nrel.gov (now NLR) no longer serves this file; the Internet Archive copy of NREL's original zip was used. Range in the five states: 3.70 to 6.17, median 5.45. ghi_overlay.png is a pre-rendered map overlay (colour ramp 4.0 to 6.4).

overlay_bounds.note: image pixels are in Web Mercator; place with these lat/lon corner bounds (e.g. Leaflet imageOverlay)

caveats: SMA shows the surface managing agency, not title. BIA lands are mapped to Tribal. ST = state lands (incl. state trust) mapped to State. PVT and UND (private or unknown) are both mapped to Private. FWS, USBR, DOE, local government and other federal are Other. Split-estate minerals are not shown. ownership.geojson keeps state, category, agency and acres per part, parts under 40 acres dropped, map copy: simplify 0.01 deg, holes and parts under 160 acres removed. source_name: AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles (terrarium encoding, zoom 11), built mainly from USGS 3DEP / NED elevation

fields.band 1: slope in percent (rise/run x 100), nodata -9999 outside the five states

caveats: Elevation from AWS Terrain Tiles at zoom 11 (~62 m ground pixels at 35N), which in the US are built mainly from USGS 3DEP/NED, so this is a 3DEP-derived product rather than a direct 3DEP download. Slope computed in Web Mercator with latitude-corrected pixel size, then averaged to a 3 arc-second (~92 m x 76 m) EPSG:4326 grid; averaging smooths short steep pitches. 55.5 percent of the five-state area exceeds 5 percent slope. slope_overlay.png is a pre-rendered overlay of the ~0.005 deg mean slope (transparent under 3 percent).

overlay_bounds.note: image pixels are in Web Mercator; place with these lat/lon corner bounds (e.g. Leaflet imageOverlay)
